description: This file defines multiple utility functions for creating GraphQL error objects with specific codes and messages, used for error handling in a GraphQL-based API. It exports functions for common error scenarios such as input errors, access denial, validation failures, extension errors, resolver errors, relationship errors, access return errors, limits exceeded, and access filtering errors.

methods.name: userInputError
methods.description: Creates a GraphQLError indicating a user input error with a custom message.

methods.name: accessDeniedError
methods.description: Creates a GraphQLError indicating access denial with a message and optional code.

methods.name: validationFailureError
methods.description: Creates a GraphQLError indicating validation failures with a list of messages.

methods.name: extensionError
methods.description: Creates a GraphQLError for extension-related errors, including error details and tags.

methods.name: resolverError
methods.description: Creates a GraphQLError for errors during input resolution, with debug info.

methods.name: relationshipError
methods.description: Creates a GraphQLError related to relationship resolution issues, with sorted debug info.

methods.name: accessReturnError
methods.description: Creates a GraphQLError for invalid values returned from access control functions.

methods.name: limitsExceededError
methods.description: Creates a GraphQLError indicating server limits have been exceeded.

methods.name: export function formatKeys(keys: string[]) { formatKeys
methods.description: Formats a list of keys, abbreviating if the list is long.

methods.name: filterAccessError
methods.description: Creates an access denied error message for filter or orderBy operations, with formatted field keys.
